frame.objective: Open one reviewed successor PR for the resource-native session kernel across all current SDK packages.

assignment: Independently re-audit the revised DKR. Re-run the exact ten rejected claims from round one and the Claude workspace-consumer/Claude-lease/proof-surface findings. Confirm exact resolvable subpath exports and build inputs; public TypeScript declarations including ToolInputError; load-and-bind and authority narrowing; current attempt tags; host root provider pre-resolution; exact provider public names; complete database-analysis acceptance sequence and validation; eval helper compatibility; Lite ^5 and SDK ^3 peer plan; all 16 walls with SHA-only custody; pkg/framework/pumped consumer migration; unchanged existing sdk-mcp; and conformance coverage for every current SDK including sandbox, scheduler, memory, pi, bash, overlap, cancellation isolation, and streaming. Run the revision probe, public checker, plain wording, hashes, and store verify. Do not edit or repair. Reject prose that still cannot be implemented from the declared public API.

budget_and_stop_rule.stop: Stop after one full round-two audit and deterministic checks.

hand_back_rule: Return exact audit traces and final accepted/rejected totals. No self-acceptance.
output_schema: Exact commands, exits, hashes, evidence, decisions, and final totals.
